verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents programmatic, UI-free account and pipeline management through its REST API, backed by a published OpenAPI spec. The Connector SDK adds coding-agent CLI plugins to build, test and deploy connectors, and the Hybrid Deployment Agent can run unattended under systemd. However, there is no documented CI integration or first-party CLI for running headlessly in a pipeline, and one community report calls the APIs unreliable, which lowers confidence. Missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration (e.g. GitHub Actions or pipeline guides), a first-party headless CLI for running syncs, independent hands-on corroboration of reliable automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Set up and scale your data pipeline, and manage your Fivetran account programmatically using the Fivetran REST API.
These skills let you build, test, and deploy connectors using natural language prompts.
You can configure `systemd` to manage the Hybrid Deployment Agent and start it automatically when the host boots.
